test_unbalanced_sub_sampling: test the unbalanced_sub_sampling function to select unique indices from a dataset with deterministic skipping
test_balanced_sub_sampling: test the balanced_sub_sampling function to select indices ensuring each label class is represented equally
build_unbalanced_sub_sampling: build a call to unbalanced_sub_sampling that selects num_samples unique indices from total_num_samples with optional skip_samples
build_balanced_sub_sampling: build a call to balanced_sub_sampling that selects num_samples indices balanced across label classes with optional skip_samples
test_test_data_limit_sub_sampling: test the TestDataLimitSubSampling test class that validates sub sampling behavior for data limit scenarios
